## Gramstax.registerLowOnMessageText() method

Registers an event handler for a bot event.

**Signature:**

```typescript
registerLowOnMessageText(): void;
```
**Returns:**

void

## Remarks

These registration methods (`registerLowOn*`<!-- -->) are designed to be overridable so subclasses can integrate with a different bot library, custom event system, or alternative routing approach. The default implementation delegates to `this.bot` to subscribe to the relevant event. Override any `registerLowOn*` method to customize how a specific event or message type is routed to its handler.
